item.text:
The archive supports a **possible $420 unapplied or unreturned deposit**. Payments total $1,320 against a $900 base rental, but a separate refund or later adjustment remains unconfirmed.

Suggested message to Harbor Room:

> Hello,
>
> Could you clarify how the $420 deposit for our 16 March 2024 event, reference HR-241, was settled?
>
> The booking terms say the deposit would be credited toward the final rental invoice unless returned separately (`01-venue/booking.txt`). The payment record shows $420 transferred on 9 January 2024 (`02-payments/transfer.txt`).
>
> However, final invoice HR-241 lists base rental of $900, deposit applied of $0, and $900 due (`01-venue/closing.txt`). The payment record shows a further $900 transferred on 20 March (`02-payments/receipt.txt`).
>
> Your 22 March message says the deposit record was under review, but does not confirm a refund (`03-messages/settlement.txt`). Could you provide the refund date and transaction reference, or explain any adjustment or deduction? If the deposit remains outstanding, please arrange its return.
>
> Thank you.

The supplied archive does not establish whether a refund or adjustment happened later, or whether a deduction was justified. The returned $420 deposit in `04-old/another-event.txt` concerns Meadow Hall in 2023 and does not resolve this Harbor Room discrepancy.
